title: DocumentIdentity payload
description: Output of the PRD §40.7 `identify(artifact)` boundary. Feeds the corpus `legal_document` table (PRD §35.2), whose `(source_id, stable_source_key)` uniqueness the builder enforces.

document_type.description: PRD §15.1 document taxonomy. NOT constrained to an enum here: packages/contracts publishes no `DocumentType` family yet (Q-CRPS-4 / FND-03). When FND-03 publishes it, this member becomes a generated enum with no other change.

authority_key.description: Natural key of the issuing authority; the builder resolves it to `authority.id`.

employer_abn.description: Australian Business Number of the employer a registered agreement covers. Public register data only — never customer data (PRD §19.2, §40.8).
